usage: The word '馬拉糕' (maa5 laai1 gou1) refers to a specific type of steamed sponge cake commonly eaten in dim sum.
It is used as a noun to name this sweet food item during meals or when ordering food.
You can say '我要一份馬拉糕' (I want a portion of steamed sponge cake) when ordering at a restaurant.
The word does not change form regardless of quantity, so context or classifiers like '份' are used to specify amounts.
It can be used on its own or with descriptors, for example, '新鮮的馬拉糕' means 'fresh steamed sponge cake'.
